## Checklist

- [ ] The title and commits follow Conventional Commits and use English.
- [ ] The change is focused, and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant checks have passed; omitted checks and reasons are documented above.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage or an explanation of its absence.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build artifacts, or unrelated dependency changes are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the project's AGPL-3.0-only license.
